name: Chang`an Archway
description: Archway, a traditional Chinese building, is used to commend meritorious service or as a landmark building. It is commonly found in gardens, temples, palaces, streets and other places. The Chang'an Street archway is located at an important location on the street, and people have to pass through it when entering or exiting. It is majestic and majestic, and its style can be felt from a distance. With its upturned eaves and horns, auspicious cranes and auspicious clouds, it contains rich national characteristics. It, together with pawnshops, rouge shops and other buildings, forms a series of puzzles called "Datang Street", which will take you on a journey to the prosperous Tang Dynasty from the microscopic world.
